shellCommands.command: ls && echo "---" && cat package.json && echo "--- next version ---" && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd /workspace && (timeout 45 npm run dev > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1; echo "started"
cd /workspace; for i in $(seq 1 20); do if grep -q "Ready\|Local:\|started server" /tmp/next-dev.log 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 1; done; cat /tmp/next-dev.log

cd /workspace; curl -s localhost:3000/ -o /dev/null -w "home: %{http_code}\n"; curl -s localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/product.html -w "product: %{http_code}\n"; echo "--- product shell (grep title/fallback) ---"; grep -o "Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|in stock" /tmp/product.html | sort -u
cd /workspace; echo "=== dev log (validation errors?) ==="; grep -i "instant\|error\|blocking\|warn\|suspense" /tmp/next-dev.log || echo "(no instant/error/warning lines)"

cd /workspace; grep -n "Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|in stock\|template" /tmp/product.html | head; echo "--- stop dev ---"; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo done
